prompt: A photorealistic 16:9 handheld documentary frame shot on a shoulder-mounted video camera with a 28mm lens, at eye level, in a near-empty sun-bleached plaza in Asunción in hot November midday light, one hard sun from high camera left. Slightly right of centre a man stands alone delivering a solemn piece to camera, framed from the knees up, holding a big black microphone at chest height in one hand and gesturing gravely with the other. He wears a creased charcoal suit, cuffs past the wrists, and plain worn brown leather gloves. His whole head is covered by a cream and oatmeal chunky rib-knit wool balaclava with visible crown decreases, tucked into his buttoned collar, one continuous unbroken knitted surface where the face would be, stray fibres glowing in the sun. A large white felt ring edged in darker thread is stitched around the face area, and a small filled solid red felt triangle with rounded corners sits high inside the ring at two o'clock, on the right side of the image. To the left a single scruffy tan stray dog sits on the hot paving stones, staring at him. Dusty benches, scattered pigeons, a distant passer-by, gentle focus falloff. Thanks.
